data.name: Aylin
data.gender_notes: Aylin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Turkish word 'ay', meaning 'moon', and the suffix '-lin', meaning 'belonging to'. Thus, Aylin means 'belonging to the moon' or 'moonlight, night'. The name Aylin carries the meaning “Moonlight, night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aylin usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aylin is believed to have spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is said to represent the light of Allah that shines on the face of the newborn child. The name is also believed to be a reminder of the peace and tranquility that comes with the presence of the divine.
data.etymology: Aylin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight, night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aylin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aylin has a rich cultural significance for people of Turkish and Islamic origin. In Turkish folklore, the moon is regarded as a symbol of beauty, tranquility, and mystery. Combining this imagery with thepersistence of the "lin" suffix, the name Aylin evokes feelings of sublime and ethereal beauty.

The name Aylin, with its connection to the moon, can be seen as a reminder of the Muslims' spiritual connection to the natural world and the passage of time. It can serve as an inspiration to live a life in harmony with the natural cycles and rhythms of the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aylin is an Islamic name meaning "moonlight, radiant, or luminous one." It represents the gentle, soothing, and calming influence of the moon on our lives, inspiring peace, introspection, and creativity.
